question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing right winger, Bob is playing center midfielder, Claire is playing cheerleader, Dave is playing goalkeeper, Eve is playing right midfielder, Fred is playing benchwarmer, and Gertrude is playing fullback.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Bob and Dave trade positions. Then, Gertrude and Eve trade positions. Then, Bob and Alice trade positions. Then, Claire and Eve trade positions. Then, Gertrude and Bob trade positions. Then, Bob and Eve trade positions. Finally, Eve and Dave trade positions. At the end of the match, Claire is playing
Options:
(A) right winger
(B) center midfielder
(C) cheerleader
(D) goalkeeper
(E) right midfielder
(F) benchwarmer
(G) fullback
solution:
Each row lists the positions in player order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: right winger | center midfielder | cheerleader | goalkeeper | right midfielder | benchwarmer | fullback
1. Bob–Dave: right winger | goalkeeper | cheerleader | center midfielder | right midfielder | benchwarmer | fullback
2. Gertrude–Eve: right winger | goalkeeper | cheerleader | center midfielder | fullback | benchwarmer | right midfielder
3. Bob–Alice: goalkeeper | right winger | cheerleader | center midfielder | fullback | benchwarmer | right midfielder
4. Claire–Eve: goalkeeper | right winger | fullback | center midfielder | cheerleader | benchwarmer | right midfielder
5. Gertrude–Bob: goalkeeper | right midfielder | fullback | center midfielder | cheerleader | benchwarmer | right winger
6. Bob–Eve: goalkeeper | cheerleader | fullback | center midfielder | right midfielder | benchwarmer | right winger
7. Eve–Dave: goalkeeper | cheerleader | fullback | right midfielder | center midfielder | benchwarmer | right winger
Claire plays fullback, option (G).
Final answer: (G)
